name: UAE National Center of Meteorology
program: UAE Research Program for Rain Enhancement Science (UAEREP)

self.title: UAEREP rain enhancement research cycle: pre-proposals

collect_note: UAEREP runs one research cycle a year; the Apply now page lists the pre-proposal deadline, which is read here so the next cycle's date is caught when the page is updated. Page is plain HTTP, not JavaScript.

sample: UAEREP rain enhancement research cycle: pre-proposals

evidence: GET apply-now page (fetch_text, 2026-11-12): 'Submit the pre-proposal by 12 March 2027, midnight GMT.' FAQ page agrees: 'pre-proposals are due on 12 March 2027.' Channels tried: no RSS or API seen in the site HTML (links are server-rendered /section/ pages); timeline page is a diagram with no text dates; the apply-now page carries the labelled date. Run discovery-2026-11-13 channels tried: http:// redirects 302 to https (no plain-HTTP route); apply.uaerep.ae, uaerep.ae, rain.ae serve the same incomplete chain (openssl code 20); sitemap.xml 404 (robots lists it); no RSS/JSON in page HTML; ncm.gov.ae (complete chain) only links out to uaerep.ae, no call text; wam.ae is a JS shell (14 KB for any URL); assets.ncm.gov.ae (complete chain) hosts only the static solicitation PDF (uaerep-2026-solicitation-c7.pdf); Technion R&D Foundation WordPress feed https://trdf.technion.ac.il/en/calls-for-proposals/feed/?s=UAEREP passes adapter_check (count 2, open 2) but both items are stale 6th-cycle posts with no deadline, so applying it would list closed calls as open: rejected. Run discovery-2026-11-17 channels tried: ncm.gov.ae sitemap.xml (88 URLs, none a UAEREP call page), ncm.gov.ae news-and-events and R&D pages (fetch_text grep UAEREP/proposal/call: no match; calls live only on uaerep.ae); www.uaerep.ae http, /rss, /feed 404, apply.uaerep.ae and www.rain.ae share the leaf-only chain (openssl code 21: cert CN www.rain.ae); portal/submit/news.uaerep.ae do not resolve; web.archive.org snapshot of the apply-now page is stale so not used; adapter_check still fails: unable to verify the first certificate.
blocker: tls_chain: production TLS failure on www.uaerep.ae (leaf cert without intermediate, openssl code 21); no other host lists the call. Re-run adapter_check after the site fixes its chain or the engine gains a per-host CA.

harness.error: fetch failed: unable to verify the first certificate
